blurb: Marc Andreessen is a co-founder of Andreessen Horowitz, one of the most influential venture capital firms in Silicon Valley. He is a prolific poster on X, sharing insights on technology, startups, crypto, and macroeconomics. With over 1.5 million followers, his tweets often spark debate and are widely shared across the tech and finance communities.
credibility_note: Andreessen is a highly credible figure in tech and venture capital, but his strong opinions on crypto and politics have drawn criticism. He has been known to promote projects his firm has invested in without always disclosing conflicts.
